notes.title: Adventure of Emberclaw Reworked
notes.notes: Welcome to the Adventure of Emberdragon, an immersive gaming experience that has undergone a complete rework to enhance its thrilling narrative and dynamic gameplay. Journey through a richly detailed world filled with enchanting landscapes, challenging quests, and vibrant characters. Players can now enjoy refined mechanics and improved graphics, making each adventure more captivating than ever. Join the heroic quest to uncover the mysteries of the Emberdragon and embrace the challenges that lie ahead as you battle fierce foes and forge lasting friendships in this epic saga.

notes.title: Patch Update December 6, 2021
notes.notes:
Patch Changes:

1) Fix the light so that you can see the shadow under your character. (This will make jumps easier)
2) Fixed a bug in level 2 were the cage throws you far away.
3) Added ability to shoot fire on boxes in level 5.
4) Added ability to shoot fire while in Air.
5) Added icon on the widget to show if attack is on cooldown

I hope you enjoy the game!
